title: Consolidated RCA and customer notices for multi-region capacity regression
creator: Aisha Patel
description: After the 2026-03-09 multi-region capacity regression, this ticket consolidates the engineering RCA, prepares customer-facing status page updates and email templates, and tracks remediation action items. Goal: finalize a short, accurate incident timeline for external comms, identify immediate mitigations that are safe to deploy, and create follow-up tickets for longer-term fixes to prevent recurrence.
timeline:
2026-03-09 02:18 UTC: First error-rate spike detected on multi-tenant pool
2026-03-09 02:22 UTC: Automated autoscaling attempts failed to provision new nodes due to a scheduler bug; p95/p99 latencies rose ~3x
2026-03-09 02:49 UTC: Fallback routing to regional reserve pools applied, partial recovery begins
2026-03-09 03:15 UTC: Traffic throttling rules applied for affected accounts to protect SLA customers
2026-03-09 04:00 UTC: Incident declared resolved from majority of users; follow-up investigation started
Notes: root cause appears to be a combined regression in the placement scheduler and a stale kernel selection rule under high queue depth.
resolution_summary: Root cause: a scheduler change (PR #7542) introduced a race when allocating burst capacity to multi-tenant GPU pools. Under high arrival rate the scheduler skipped updating kernel-selection metadata, leaving some replicas configured with incompatible kernels and causing provisioning failures. Immediate mitigation was to rollback the scheduler change and route traffic to reserve pools. Longer term fixes include improved scheduler testing, guardrails around kernel metadata mutation, and capacity reservations for critical customers.
action_items: ENG-6290: Create automated test that simulates high arrival bursts and validates kernel metadata propagation (owner: Priya Shah, ETA: 2026-03-20)
ENG-6291: Add a safe-mode in scheduler to pause kernel-selector updates during allocation spikes (owner: Diego Morales, ETA: 2026-03-24)
ENG-6302: Implement capacity reservation primitives for tiered customers and document SLOs (owner: Marco Li, ETA: 2026-04-07)
OPS-401: Statuspage automation to post precise timeline and a customer-facing summary after RCA sign-off (owner: Elena Novak, ETA: 2026-03-15)
DOCS-78: Draft and publish incident FAQ and guidance for customers who saw transient errors (owner: Samir Khan, ETA: 2026-03-17)
